title: The log viewer of Zoraxy admin panel fails to neutralize the output properly, that may cause an arbitrary script to be…
description: The Zoraxy admin panel's log viewer does not properly neutralize output, allowing arbitrary scripts to execute in the administrator's browser. This vulnerability is classified as a cross-site scripting (XSS) issue (CWE-79). It has a CVSS 3.0 score of 6.1, indicating medium severity. No affected versions or patch information are provided, and there are no known exploits in the wild.
